data.name: Fiendish Aspect
data.description: A fiendflesh shifter can temporarily transform her body into an amalgam of otherworldly evil creatures as a swift action. While in this form, the fiendflesh shifter gains darkvision out to a range of 60 feet (or doubles the range of her darkvision if she already has it), a gore natural attack that deals 1d6 points of damage (1d4 points of damage if the shifter is Small), and DR %1/good. A fiendflesh shifter can maintain this form for %2 minutes per day. The duration does not need to be consecutive but must be spent in 1-minute increments.|FiendfleshShifterDR|3+ShifterLVL
